purpose: Self-contained laptop integration contract; no sample output may replace the live full-cohort dashboard.

portable_bundle.release_manifest.json: Release/cohort identity, immutable code/config/input metadata digests, all252 jobs and selected validated attempts; final release state and limitations.
portable_bundle.code/: Frozen three SAS entry scripts, dependencies, local controller and independent validators; local input paths supplied outside portable bundle.
portable_bundle.methods/decisions.json: Every approved scientific and technical choice, date, evidence, superseded implementation and unresolved status.
portable_bundle.methods/methodology.txt: Plain language estimands, populations, model formulae, variance/DF algorithms, units, exclusions, missingness, sensitivity and multiplicity rules.
portable_bundle.schemas/: Versioned exact CSV names/columns/types/keys/units/status vocabulary; no consumer guesses from labels.
portable_bundle.results/preparation/: Validated aggregate flow, exclusions, preparation and population/follow-up status; no record-level tables.
portable_bundle.results/populations/{PopulationId}/: Validated aggregate descriptions, QA and paired observed summaries including joint covariance.
portable_bundle.results/models/{JobID}/working/: Original fitted mean-model archive with model-based uncertainty explicitly labelled diagnostic.
portable_bundle.results/models/{JobID}/inference/: Validated person-cluster inference, trajectories, changes, pairwise comparisons, both joint tests, availability and frozen families.
portable_bundle.validation/: Independent software/version/digest-bound attestations, resource summary and exact accepted bundle inventory.

local_only: Per-person QR factors, residuals and sufficient statistics
consumer_rules: Read only files explicitly selected by release_manifest.json; never glob the latest modification time.
Require matching cohort and release identities; development_sample is never a production replacement.
Use person-cluster inference for final numerical reporting; working-model residual-DF tables are not final inference.
Use explicit availability/status values. Missing uncertainty is never zero or nonsignificance.
Keep endpoint change heterogeneity distinct from whole-trajectory time-by-factor interaction.
Keep same-fit prediction changes distinct from secondary observed paired window summaries.
Pointwise confidence intervals and Holm-adjusted primaryFULL pairwise P values have different meanings.
Read unit status before labelling axes or converting values. Planned units in originalhandoff are not verified source units.
Future linear contrasts require the declared archived scoring span and its covariance/DF method; do not infer arbitrary new coefficient validity.
Preserve full planned252 job registry and all unavailable rows/reasons; never silently omit failed or unavailable requests.

ESTIMATED_ZERO_COVARIANCE preserves a numerically zero covariance estimate for supported components; its DF is missing and standalone zero-variance intervals remain unavailable. It is not an assertion of known population covariance, and may support a valid pairwise comparison.
ScoreIdentityNorm is an arithmetic reconstruction certificate for the observed joint covariance. It is not clinical variability, a standard error, or an extra uncertainty term to add to intervals.

count_definitions.N_Input: Selected outcome rows within the requested population before fit eligibility/complete-case filtering (new outcome-pushdown meaning).
count_definitions.N_Patients: Distinct person clusters in the exact estimation population.
count_definitions.N_Admissions: Distinct verified admissions in the exact estimation population; separate from persons and events.
count_definitions.N_Events: Distinct canonical simultaneous-transfusion events in the exact estimation population.
count_definitions.N_Used: Actual complete-case longitudinal observations used in that working mean fit.

restart_policy: Fresh isolated attempt for a retry; never mix artifacts from different attempts. Revalidate completed artifacts without rerunning SAS. Unchanged accepted attempts remain immutable.
retention_policy: Keep previous development evidence unchanged. New per-attempt private WORK may be retired only after all required validation and durable attestation; covariance/DF sufficient information stays in approved model-only archives.
privacy: Portable code/configuration and only reviewed model/aggregate outputs. No source records, source paths, per-person results or raw logs.

numeric_exchange.numeric_token: H followed by sixteen uppercase IEEE754 binary64 hexadecimal digits
numeric_exchange.character_fields: Preserved as character text even if they resemble numeric tokens
numeric_exchange.consumer_format: Ordinary decimal CSV must be generated by the supplied schema-aware exact-to-repr conversion, with source and destination hashes recorded. Do not ask the dashboard to infer cell types.
numeric_exchange.legacy_decimal: E32_STDIEEE identifies older evidence only and carries no all-binary64 exactness guarantee.

diagnostic_bundle_rule: An explicit subset writes validation_bundle_manifest.json with DiagnosticOnly=true and PRIVATE_UNREVIEWED. Complete sample collection requires252model+4report selections; neither implies scientific/full-cohort approval.
collection_provenance: Collector/codec code hashes, source validation digests and per-file source/decimal hashes are retained; completed manifests written last; failed partial collection cannot become a release.
